newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan Nov leading index seen at 77.8.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan Nov leading index seen at 77.8.

text.p: A poll of economic institutions gave a forecast for Japan's November diffusion index of leading economic indicators of 77.8 on a scale of 100, above the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50 for a third straight month.
A figure for the leading index above 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months.
The coincident index, which measures current economic conditions, is forecast at 100 in November.
The government's Economic Planning Agency will release the official figures on Friday.
In October, the leading index was 83.3, while the coincident index was 90.0.
DKB Research Institute forecast that the leading index would likely remain above the 50 mark in December and January with production maintaining its uptrend.
